title: 서북도서방위사령부령 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 6 (Establishment of Departments and Units)
(1) The Northwestern Islands Defense Command shall have staff departments and units necessary for its operation and may organize a joint staff, including personnel of the Army and Air Force, where necessary.
(2) Matters concerning the establishment and allocation of duties of the staff departments under paragraph (1) shall be determined by the Chief of Naval Operations, and matters concerning the composition of the joint staff and the establishment, missions, and organization of units shall be determined by the Minister of National Defense.
